title: [docdb] Losing raft leadership if applying write takes too long
body:
Jira Link: [DB-1746](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-1746)
I was looking at some more recent test failures. Have noticed stuff like this recently: https://detective-gcp.dev.yugabyte.com/job/github-yugabyte-db-phabricator%2F34589%2Fartifact%2Fjava%2Fyb-pgsql%2Ftarget%2Fsurefire-reports_org.yb.pgsql.TestPgDropDatabase__testBasicDropDatabase%2Forg.yb.pgsql.TestPgDropDatabase-output.txt?max_lines=3000&start_line=9001

`CreateNamespace` being slow has consistently been a thing. Recently @iSignal split it so instead of 1 massive 64MB+ raft write, it at least goes in smaller batches (10k items at a time by default).

What I noticed were CatalogManager errors like `Operation submitted in term 2 cannot be replicated in term 3`. This felt strange, as it suggests the master leader lost leadership. But from the logs, it felt like it was clearly making progress, replicating batches…slowly, but steadily!
```
08:07:50.629619  4387 sys_catalog.cc:778] CopyPgsqlTables: Batch# 1 copied 10000 rows with 16928165 bytes
08:08:07.396157  4387 sys_catalog.cc:778] CopyPgsqlTables: Batch# 2 copied 10000 rows with 27993797 bytes
08:08:12.873781  4387 sys_catalog.cc:778] CopyPgsqlTables: Batch# 3 copied 10000 rows with 7333366 bytes
```

Digging further, you notice warnings like:
> W0430 08:08:11.549810  3866 yb_rpc.cc:426] Call yb.consensus.ConsensusService.UpdateConsensus 127.183.239.91:58977 => 127.60.130.223:22499 (request call id 1346) took 4080ms (client timeout 3000ms).

And more explicitly, highlighting maybe the problem
```

m2|pid3814|:22499     @     0x7f845510b74a  yb::(anonymous namespace)::HandleStackTraceSignal(int) (src/yb/util/debug-util.cc:277)

m2|pid3814|:22499     @     0x7f8454ffc837·
m2|pid3814|:22499     @     0x7f84551ee627  yb::util::FastDecodeSignedVarInt(yb::Slice*) (src/yb/util/fast_varint.cc:230)
m2|pid3814|:22499     @     0x7f8460b2ec66  yb::docdb::PrimitiveValue::DecodeKey(yb::Slice*, yb::docdb::PrimitiveValue*) (src/yb/docdb/primitive_value.cc:877)

m2|pid3814|:22499     @     0x7f8460b0a1f3  yb::Status yb::docdb::SubDocKey::DoDecode<yb::docdb::SubDocKey::DecodeCallback>(yb::Slice*, yb::StronglyTypedBool<yb::docdb::HybridTimeRequired_Tag>, yb::docdb::SubDocKey::DecodeCallback const&) (src/yb/docdb/doc_key.cc:672)
m2|pid3814|:22499     @     0x7f8460afc4f1  yb::docdb::SubDocKey::DecodeFrom(yb::Slice*, yb::StronglyTypedBool<yb::docdb::HybridTimeRequired_Tag>) (src/yb/docdb/doc_key.cc:648)
m2|pid3814|:22499     @     0x7f8460afcdb2  yb::docdb::SubDocKey::FullyDecodeFrom(yb::Slice const&, yb::StronglyTypedBool<yb::docdb::HybridTimeRequired_Tag>) (src/yb/docdb/doc_key.cc:706)

m2|pid3814|:22499     @     0x7f8468b3d19b  yb::tablet::Tablet::ApplyOperationState(yb::tablet::OperationState const&, long, yb::docdb::KeyValueWriteBatchPB const&) (src/yb/tablet/tablet.cc:997)
m2|pid3814|:22499     @     0x7f8468b3cefb  yb::tablet::Tablet::ApplyRowOperations(yb::tablet::WriteOperationState*) (src/yb/tablet/tablet.cc:983)
m2|pid3814|:22499     @     0x7f8468d2982e  yb::tablet::WriteOperation::DoReplicated(long, yb::Status*) (src/yb/tablet/operations/write_operation.cc:127)
m2|pid3814|:22499     @     0x7f8468cf7d78  yb::tablet::Operation::Replicated(long) (src/yb/tablet/operations/operation.cc:63)
```

Seems like if an apply step takes too long, the followers might trigger their failure detector?
